_comment: The docs graph's sub-graphs, declared from within, in the same shape as the base harness's `docs/docs.json`; paths are relative to this file's directory.
name: smart-base

directories.description: This instance's docs source: one directory per generated page (`<group>-<slug>/`), holding its authored blocks (`.md`), its manifests (`.ts`) and their generated `.jsonld`. The platform's docs-page run (`gen-docs-pages.ts`), which reads the docs source every mounted instance declares, renders each into the page beside it (`<group>/<slug>.md`), and the site build composes this directory under `/smart-base/`. `compose-docs` leaves `source/` out, so a block is never published as a page of its own.
